blocking.title: A landing whose transports are sunk at sea: its drowned divisions are told 'not done: no transports of its nation with room for it are at a port it can reach' and nothing says they were lost; landingInvariants aboardNoLanding (seed 19113, setup 15101, t1463)
blocking.fix: In landingSystem, tell a sailing landing whose groups were sunk apart from one that put all ashore (landings.ts 'All it carried ashore' branch): a division aboard a group that is gone is lost with it (or put ashore), not refused with NoTransports; tell the player (an order news kind such as 'lost at sea with its transports'); no nextVoyage panel state for it. AT: landingInvariants 19113/15101 no aboardNoLanding; a unit case of a sailing landing whose group is destroyed (no MoveRejected, the news names the sinking); landingInvariants on ten new seeds per setup with no aboardNoLanding.
